comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body: No matter what folks tell you, no item ever has a universally "right" price. Just try selling it for a figure of your choosing, and if it fails to sell, lower the price until you're successful.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Additionally, 30k total fame is required to equip these. They come randomly from all three types of Historical Chests awarded during World Clock related Historical Events.
